scope: Explicit canonical connector admission, exact project/session/request scope binding, reversible runtime enable/disable, permanent generation revocation/removal, deterministic registry rebuild and installed observed-goal composition.
review_provenance: Single-agent requirement, architecture, automation and test role passes; no independent reviewer or approval is claimed.

commands: cargo test -p gateway-application --test connector_admission --test connector_manifest --test connector_policy --test connector_resilience --test connectors --locked

CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_LLVM_COV_TARGET_DIR=target/mcp-client-coverage python3 scripts/cognitive-test-host.py -- cargo llvm-cov -p gateway-application -p gateway-daemon --lib --test connector_admission --test mcp_client --test observed_goal_sessions --test complete_before_sessions --no-clean --locked --json --output-path target/connector-admission-coverage-final.json -- --test-threads=1

acceptance.proof: Only exact enabled canonical registrations can bind policy or construct private plugin hosts; unknown, missing, duplicate and mismatched adapters deny.
Project, session, request and ContextScopeId match exactly; scope collisions and foreign bindings deny. Each host owns its session and inventory; normalized results retain CG-06 scope.
Canonical rebuild is order independent. Invalid replacement preserves the running candidate; successful replacement revokes old generations and requires fresh connection/discovery.
Disable/shutdown close admission before cleanup. Enable clears inventory; removal permanently revokes the generation. In-flight mutation cancellation retains unknown effect and is not retried.
Duplicate/conflicting connector or server identities and incompatible manifests fail atomic registry validation.
Immutable operator-owned registry has no project/discovery write path. Installed composition reads pinned canonical runtime definitions and authenticated durable project/session/run identity.

limits: MCP peer effects use the independent controlled Python conformance server, not a live provider.
Database/installed binary scenarios use actual disposable PostgreSQL and the instrumented cg-mcp executable.
Runtime disable/removal persist across restart only when reflected in canonical enabled/membership configuration.
Coverage accumulates unchanged production source through the final comprehensive --no-clean run; all six required suites execute in that final run.
An earlier overlapping coverage attempt failed due to build-artifact cleanup and is excluded from this qualification.
The full workspace/release gate and parent #223 live-provider acceptance are not claimed by this scoped qualification.
